runs.reason: first run; 1000 epochs finished and checkpoint_final.pth written. nnU-Net then crashed in its own post-training validation (Some background workers are no longer alive); that validation is not the graded result and the checkpoint is intact.

launcher.note: The launcher was replaced AFTER this run finished, to fix the missing sentinel and the -chk extension that its own failure exposed. sha256 is the script that actually ran, captured before the edit; sha256_on_disk_when_recorded is what the file holds now. Recording the current file as the one that ran would be false provenance.

split.kind: frozen, blocked by the 50 mm bins of the bands file
split.boundary_limit: a training slice and a validation slice can be adjacent across a bin boundary (minimum distance 1 slice, 0.333 mm, in all four folds); the blocking stops a shuffled-slice split, not the boundary pair. The graded bands keep their 10 mm buffers and are never sampled.
split.fold_0_rationale: bin 0 holds the fewest primary slices, so fold 0 leaves the most for training; fixed before any score existed
split.inference_checkpoint: checkpoint_final: the validation fold reports, it never selects

ignore_encoding.reason: nnU-Net asserts the ignore label equals max(labels) + 1 and refuses 255
ignore_encoding.scope: the derived nnU-Net label files only; tissue-classes.nii.gz and its pinned hash are untouched
ignore_encoding.collision: the registry meaning of 4 (ligament-tendon) is not declared in this dataset; the builder refuses a source volume that already holds 4 or 5

slice_axis_spacing.reason: nnU-Net orders the axes by spacing and puts the largest first; with the true 0.333 mm the singleton axis was reordered into the middle and the 2D planner produced a [1, 704] patch, one-pixel strips instead of slices
slice_axis_spacing.scope: the derived nnU-Net cases only; the graded volume is rebuilt on the reference affine

limits: the prior channels are an input, never a target: the reference stays the Denver original labels through the tissue map
the ignore label is 4 inside the nnU-Net dataset and 255 in the reference; the two encodings must never be compared directly
a 2D configuration sees one slice at a time; no through-plane context
the frozen split reports only; the graded result is the band prediction
nnUNetv2_train has no seed flag; the value is the one the launcher applies to random, numpy and torch in the main process
nnU-Net passes seeds=None to its batch-generator workers, so augmentation is unseeded and the run is not bit-reproducible
cuDNN benchmarking is on by default, which makes some kernels non-deterministic as well
the declared run history is checked against one training log per training start; a run that left no log on this box cannot be seen here
